title: Configuration within a work-tape window
statement: Let a configuration of a $k$-tape Turing machine on input $x$ have work-head positions $p_i$ and work-tape contents $T_i : \mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Symbol})$. For a natural number $s$, the configuration is within the window of radius $s$ if every work-head position satisfies $|p_i|\le s$, and every tape cell $z$ with $|z|>s$ is blank on every work tape.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration of a $k$-tape machine over symbol type $\mathrm{Symbol}$ and state type $\mathrm{State}$ on input word $x$
